findings.correction: Those who survive are strong, and only the strong will survive.
findings.current: The strong will survive, and only those who survive will be strong.
findings.defect: The two clauses are reversed, so the System defines strength as a consequence of surviving instead of stating that survivors are strong and only the strong survive.
findings.rationale: Source order is 살아남는 자가 강하고 then 강한 자만이 살아남을 것입니다. Swapping them changes the quest text’s causal claim.
findings.source: 살아남는 자가 강하고, 강한 자만이 살아남을 것입니다.

findings.correction: The question that had briefly arisen vanished the moment he saw the coachman’s sharp eyes.
findings.current: The question that had briefly arisen vanished the moment I saw the coachman’s sharp eyes.
findings.defect: Added first-person “I” in a gate-guard focalized scene, so Taekyung appears to be at the gate seeing the coachman.
findings.rationale: The surrounding beats (범상치 않다, 수문위사 swallowing, blocking the carriage) belong to the gate guard. The Korean has no 내가; Taekyung is still in the Lesser Family Head’s office.
findings.source: 잠깐 떠오른 의문은 마부의 날카로운 눈매를 보는 순간 잊혔다.

findings.correction: But that had merely been the Head Elder’s clever way of speaking—a suggestion that perhaps we should back down at this point.
findings.current: But that had merely been the Head Elder’s clever way of speaking—a suggestion that perhaps they should back down at this point.
findings.defect: “They” points at the rebels; the rhetoric is that the kill proposal really meant we/the family should stop here.
findings.rationale: Wipeng’s 제안 is killing the rebels; Taekyung says that speech was a feint whose real import is 이 정도에서 물러나는 게 어떻겠냐. If Wikyung had accepted 그 제안, 혈사 follows—so 물러나는 is de-escalation by Wikyung’s side, not the rebels withdrawing.
findings.source: 하지만 그것은 대장로의 교묘한 화법에 불과했다. 이 정도에서 물러나는 게 어떻겠냐는.

findings.correction: Why is noona coming out of there…?
findings.current: Why is she showing up here…?
findings.defect: Drops 누나, 거기서 나와, and the set comic line, turning a specific punchline into generic surprise.
findings.rationale: The Korean is the stock meme wording, used as Taekyung’s reaction, not a kinship claim and not merely “why is she here.”

findings.defect: 기울였다 is tilting/drinking, not merely lifting.
findings.rationale: 찻잔을 기울이다 is the drinking gesture; lift is a different action.
He is hiding the failed lift after ignoring Wikyung; manner is stealth, not tempo.

findings.correction: What the hell? Why won’t she lift?
findings.current: What the hell? Why wouldn’t she move?
findings.defect: 안 들려 is failure to lift her, not failure to make her move.
findings.rationale: The next lines are weight, Strength, and 못 든다; the blocked action is lifting.

findings.defect: Game UI panel is missing the required System blockquote heading used for the quest window.
findings.rationale: Binding Markdown rule: each actual System-message panel is one blockquote headed System. This is the Level Window over her head.

findings.correction: The timing was damn awful, too.
findings.rationale: Profanity rules: neither intensify nor sanitize; 더럽게 marks the narrator’s irritation.

summary: The System maxim in the War quest is clause-reversed; the gate scene inserts Taekyung as “I” where the guard is the perceiver; Wikyung’s “back down” subject and the 누나가 왜 거기서 나와 beat are also off.
